title: Mail columns and sorting
blurb: Date, Time, Recipient, Sender and Subject headers sort all matching downloaded mail before paging, in folders including Inbox, Drafts and Sent and All Account Mail. Click again to reverse direction; the choice is remembered on this device. Drag headers to reorder columns independently of sorting, or use Columns and its Move left / Move right buttons, or Alt + Left / Right on a header. Right-click a header, or focus one and press Shift + F10, to choose visible columns. Columns offers the same checkboxes for keyboard and touch. Subject always stays visible; Show all columns restores visibility. Hiding a sorted column keeps its sort. Keyboard moves use visible neighbors while preserving hidden columns in the saved order. Reset column order restores Date, Time, Recipient, Sender, Subject without changing visibility. Reply / forward indicators are inline subject prefixes, not a column or sort option; legacy saved status-column preferences are ignored. A paperclip before the subject marks messages with file attachments, including in Outbox. Layout is saved in settings.json and shared by all mailboxes, search and Outbox. Cancelling a drag leaves the order unchanged. Drag a visible header’s right-edge resize handle to set its width, or focus the handle and use Left / Right (Shift for larger steps). An automatic column at or above its fixed-width limit keeps its responsive width when you try to widen it. Escape cancels a resize; Delete / Backspace or double-clicking the handle restores its responsive default. Widths are saved by column ID and remain attached to that column when reordered or hidden; untouched columns keep their responsive defaults. Older saved layouts gain Time immediately after Date while keeping other columns in order; an explicitly saved Time position is preserved. Other missing columns are appended and unknown or duplicate saved columns are ignored. Recipient shows all To recipients and sorts by the first; missing text sorts first ascending and last descending. Sender sorts by the saved display name when available, otherwise the cached From text. Separate Date and Time columns use the existing message timestamp (saved time for local drafts) and device timezone. In the mail list, Date shows Today or Yesterday for those local calendar dates, then your selected date format for other dates. Labels refresh across local midnight and after waking without replacing focused rows. Time, Outbox and other date displays keep their existing formats. Their tooltips include the full timestamp, timezone and exact UTC timestamp. Both headers sort by the full timestamp, including the date, rather than time of day alone. Missing or invalid timestamps leave both cells empty. Equal values use message ID for stable ordering. Changing sort returns to the first page and keeps the reader open. Ordinary selections remain only for rows on that page; selections retained when filtering also stay selected across later sorts, even when outside that page. Search sorts all downloaded matches before its existing 100-result limit. Filter downloaded view matches a case-insensitive literal phrase in subject, sender and preview across the selected downloaded folder or view, including Local Folders, before paging. In an account’s Drafts folder, it also matches any saved To address or name, even when Recipient is hidden. It preserves scope, To Me, flags and sort, with exact matching totals and 200-row pages. The current page stays visible while you type. Results update after a short pause or after finishing text composition. Search filters only its returned results (up to 100); Outbox filters its loaded rows. It does not download older mail or search the server. Narrow lists scroll horizontally. Outbox retains scheduled send order and its sorting headers are disabled. The Recipient column accepts downloaded address arrays and formatted Outbox summaries, including multiple recipients across accounts; empty To fields show (no recipient), including CC/BCC-only sends. In Drafts, when the Recipient column is hidden, choose Show draft recipients to read the To line on each draft row. The preview turns off when you leave or switch Drafts, change the reading layout, restore the Recipient column, or restart Morrow. Undownloaded provider mail is not included.
